integrity: The exhaustive finite enumeration and its independent Burnside count are reproducible from embedded Python code; no independent mathematical review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite cutoff through four points, and one five-point witness. No claim about an unrestricted five-state census, larger systems, function-symbol logic, or absolute identification among all binary relational structures. Historical priority provisional.
title: The first counting-logic collision for two-letter transition systems
